sourceProvenance.media: artifact-owned role-scoped media registries; this shared release contains no editorial, evidence, data-visualization, map, or social-preview media

resolutionPolicy: Every artifact resolves the exact asset, role, surface, approval, rights, and byte hash. An unresolved role blocks public delivery or remains an internal preview under OUTPUT-CLARITY-01; it is never rendered as an audience caveat.

identity.defaultUse: normal header, first encounter, and corporate signature after approval

rights.conditions: A separately approved role and surface record is required before delivery.

identity.note: Evidence source only. Public use resolves a separate role-scoped approval with surface, clear-space, minimum-size, and delivery records.

textIdentityImplementations.fontPolicy: Select exactly one typographyBindings record for the delivered surface and runtime. The selected binding fixes font source, family, weight, size, minimum size, tracking, line height, clear space, substitution, final-output behavior, and verification fixtures.
textIdentityImplementations.note: This is the approved canonical portfolio name rendered as text. It satisfies identity presence when no role-approved logo asset exists; it is not a logo, wordmark reconstruction, or substitute asset.

iconSubsets.note: FILL 1 variants are excluded from v0.9.1.

fallbacks.displayLatin: Georgia, Cambria, Times New Roman, serif
fallbacks.displayThai: Noto Sans Thai Looped, Leelawadee UI, Tahoma, sans-serif

fallbacks.interfaceIcon: approved inline vector or visible text label; never a missing-glyph box
